title: ModCore Library
description: Essential library mod providing utilities and APIs for Minecraft mod developers. Simplifies registration, networking, config management, and more.
body: ModCore Library is a comprehensive utility library designed to streamline Minecraft mod development. This lightweight library provides essential tools and helper classes that eliminate boilerplate code and accelerate the development process. It includes Registry Helper for simplified registration, Config Helper for easy configuration management, Network Helper for streamlined packet creation, and Text Helper for convenient text handling. Perfect for both novice and experienced developers, it's non-intrusive and adds zero gameplay content, making it an ideal dependency for other mods.
